title: Sensodyne Repair & Protect Whitening 4-Pack vs Equate Restore & Defend Whitening

bundle.name: Sensodyne Repair and Protect Whitening Toothpaste, Mint, 3.4 oz, 4 Pack

items.name: Repair & Protect Whitening, tubes 1 to 3 (3 x 3.4 oz)

components.product: Equate Restore and Defend Sensitive Whitening Toothpaste, 3.4 oz, 3-pack
Equate Restore and Defend Sensitive Whitening Toothpaste, 3.4 oz

summary: Equate Restore & Defend Sensitive Whitening has the same 0.454% stannous fluoride as Sensodyne Repair & Protect Whitening.
evidence: Walmart's Sensodyne Repair and Protect Whitening 4-pack (four 3.4 oz tubes) lists stannous fluoride 0.454%. Walmart's Equate Restore and Defend Sensitive Whitening listing states 'Stannous Fluoride 0.454% W/W (0.15% W/v Fluoride Ion)'. One Equate 3-pack plus one single tube gives the same 13.6 oz. In November 2026 Walmart listed the Sensodyne 4-pack at $23.49 ($1.73/oz) and Equate at $4.44 a tube or $11.99 for a 3-pack ($1.18/oz), so four Equate tubes cost $16.43.
differences: Only the active was compared. We didn't see either inactive list, so the whitening (stain-removing) abrasives, flavor and texture may differ. Sensodyne has far more ratings (13.6K vs 1,228), both averaging 4.6. We couldn't confirm that Walmart itself sells the Sensodyne 4-pack.

title: Head & Shoulders Clinical Strength Twin Pack vs Equate Selenium Sulfide 1% Shampoo

items.name: Clinical Strength Dry Scalp Rescue 13.5 fl oz, bottle 1
Clinical Strength Dry Scalp Rescue 13.5 fl oz, bottle 2

components.product: Equate Medicated Dandruff Shampoo, Selenium Sulfide 1%, 11 fl oz
Equate Medicated Dandruff Shampoo, Selenium Sulfide 1%, 11 fl oz

summary: Equate Medicated Dandruff Shampoo has the same 1% selenium sulfide as Head & Shoulders Clinical Strength.
evidence: Walmart lists the H&S Clinical Strength Dry Scalp Rescue Twin Pack (two 13.5 fl oz bottles) with 1% selenium sulfide. The Equate Medicated Dandruff Shampoo label (NDC 49035-534-01, distributed by Wal-Mart) lists Selenium Sulfide 1%. In November 2026 Walmart listed the H&S twin pack at $22.97 (85.1¢/fl oz) and a single bottle at $11.97, and the Equate 11 fl oz at $4.84 (44.0¢/fl oz) or $14.52 for a 3-pack.
differences: Equate compares itself to Selsun Blue, not H&S. Its base is ammonium laureth/lauryl sulfate with menthol and fragrance, and it isn't sold as a dry-scalp moisturizing formula like H&S Dry Scalp Rescue, so it may feel less conditioning. Equate bottles are 11 fl oz, so it takes about 2.5 bottles to match 27 fl oz; two bottles give 22 fl oz. H&S rates higher at Walmart (4.7 vs 4.5).
